name: Education Of Children
overview: Scripture teaches that the education of children is a sacred responsibility entrusted to parents, who are to diligently instruct their children in the ways of the Lord throughout daily life, as emphasized in Deuteronomy 11:19. Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), underscoring their value and the importance of nurturing them wisely. Biblical wisdom encourages loving discipline, warning that sparing the rod is harmful, while timely correction reflects true love (Proverbs 13:24). Furthermore, a child's receptiveness to instruction brings joy to parents, while foolishness brings sorrow (Proverbs 15:5, 15:20). Ultimately, acquiring wisdom and understanding is portrayed as more precious than wealth, highlighting the supreme importance of godly education (Proverbs 16:16).
